caption: The drawing depicts a single object that resembles an old-fashioned metal box iron with a hinged lid, sitting on a small stand. The iron has a curved handle at the top, attached to the main body with two upright supports, and the handle appears to be wrapped or coated in a different material, possibly wood. There is a large, round knob attached to a cylindrical lever or rod extending horizontally to the left side of the iron. The main body of the iron is somewhat rectangular and features three equally spaced circular openings on its front face, and there are wing-like metallic elements protruding from each side, possibly for adjusting or opening the iron. The overall shading of the drawing is in grayscale, using varying tones of pencil or charcoal to create a sense of three-dimensionality and cast shadow, which appears to fall to the right side and slightly backward from the object. The background is plain with a gradient from light to a slightly darker top edge, with no additional objects or decorative elements present.
title: Flat Iron
